description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Motorola Solutions is hiring a Software Engineer to develop and maintain .NET C# microservices, databases, and cloud solutions. The role supports the expansion of the company’s messaging capabilities and delivery of next-generation messaging solutions.
Software Engineer collaborating to architect, develop, and deploy .NET C# microservices and test application reliability

Responsibilities:
• Engage in Agile/Scrum methodologies— participating in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to optimize team performance
• Collaborative Development: Work within a global, multi-site environment, leveraging best practices in code reviews, testing, software engineering and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD)
• Quality Assurance: Design and execute a comprehensive suite of tests—including unit, integration, system, load, and acceptance tests—to ensure the integrity and reliability of our applications
• Microservices Architecture: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect, develop, and deploy microservices using .NET C# that meet scalability and performance benchmarks
• Ongoing learning: Staying up to date with the latest technologies and industry trends. Contribute to the improvement of existing software development processes
• Continuous Improvement and Learning: Proactively contribute to enhancing existing software development processes. Maintain current knowledge of the latest technologies and industry trends

Requirements:
• Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline

Preferred:
• Solid understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented programming (OOP) principles, and design patterns
• Proficiency in .NET C# and Node.js
• Experience in building and deploying RESTful microservices
• Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL database technologies (e.g., MongoDB, PostgreSQL)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug complex systems
• Proficient with version control systems, particularly Git
• Knowledge of frontend frameworks like AngularJS is a plus
• Understanding of Pub-Sub systems and message brokers (e.g., Service Bus, Event Hubs or Event Grid, RabbitMQ, Kafka) is a plus
• Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure is advantageous
